title: [PDF] CITY HOLDING COMPANY - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond
summary: This source is a routine FR Y-6 Annual Report of Holding Companies filed by City Holding Company (a regional bank holding company in Charleston, West Virginia) with the Federal Reserve for fiscal year ending December 31, 2021. It contains standard regulatory compliance information including organizational charts, shareholder listings, and director/officer information. The source is not relevant to market structure or macro catalysts as it contains no policy analysis, market observations, or economic commentary.
key_points: City Holding Company is a bank holding company headquartered in Charleston, WV, registered with NASDAQ Global Select Market under trading symbol CHCO.
Report date is for fiscal year ending December 31, 2021; Form 10-K was filed with the SEC on February 24, 2022.
The document is a required regulatory filing (FR Y-6) under the Bank Holding Company Act, Dodd-Frank Act, and other statutes.
CEO and President is Charles R. Hageboeck; CFO is David Bumgarner.
Company has 5% or greater shareholders but no principal shareholders as defined in the filing instructions.
The source is hosted by the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond as part of annual report batches.
